neighbours.label: herb, spice and tea preparation steps (bash the pods, steep the herb, add ginger)
fire: Lightly crush the cardamom pods in a mortar before adding them.
Steep two teaspoons of dried chamomile in a cup of hot water.
Add the grated ginger, turmeric and cumin and stir for a minute.
Toast the cumin seeds in a dry pan until fragrant.
Simmer the cinnamon sticks and cloves in the milk for five minutes.
Grind the black peppercorns and coriander seeds together.
Pour boiling water over the mint leaves and let them infuse.
Stir the saffron threads into a spoonful of warm water.
quiet: Lightly brown the chicken pieces in a pan before adding them.
Slice two potatoes thinly and lay them in the dish.
Add the diced carrots, celery and onion and stir for a minute.
Fry the bacon in a dry pan until crisp.
Simmer the chopped tomatoes in the pot for five minutes.
Cut the bread into cubes and set them aside.
Pour the beaten eggs over the vegetables and let them set.
Stir the rice into the pot with the chicken stock.
